subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 2: Story – The secret shed
outcomes: Understand the main events of the story The secret shed.
Say if sentences about the story are true or false and correct them.
Say where food comes from: plants or animals.

tf.s: Fatma can't make sandwiches because there isn't any bread.
Bo puts lemonade on the noodles.
There's some bread in Fatma's kitchen.
tf.why: There isn't any bread in Fatma's kitchen.

tf.s: There is some bread at Lottie's house.
Lemonade comes from a lemonade lake.
tf.why: Lemonade comes from lemons, and lemons grow on trees.

tf.s: The children form a team called the Discovery Team.
tf.why: Well done! Let's form a team, the Discovery Team!

tf.s: The children find an old shed at the back of the garden.
tf.why: Yes! They can have their team meetings there.
Butter comes from milk, from an animal (cows).

tf.s: You drink lemonade; you don't put it on noodles.
The Discovery Team's symbol is a lemon tree.
tf.why: The symbol is a dinosaur model.

boxes.q: What does Bo put on the noodles?
boxes.why: Bo puts lemonade on the noodles.

boxes.q: What do they find at the back of the garden?
What is the name of the team?

mcq.q: What do the children form in the story?
mcq.why: Let's form a team, the Discovery Team!

mcq.q: What can the children do in the old shed?
mcq.why: The shed is their meeting place.

mcq.q: Which foods are in the story?
mcq.why: Cheese, bread, noodles and lemonade are in the story.

mcq.q: What is the Discovery Team symbol?
mcq.why: The symbol is a dinosaur model.

mcq.q: Correct the sentence: 'Bo puts coffee on noodles.'
mcq.why: In the story, Bo puts lemonade on the noodles.

mcq.q: True or false: 'There's some bread in Fatma's kitchen.'
o: True – there is a lot of bread.
False – there is some cheese only at Lottie's.
mcq.why: There isn't any bread in Fatma's kitchen.

mcq.q: Which food comes from an animal?
mcq.why: Butter comes from milk, from cows.

mcq.q: What does Bo learn in the story?
o: Lemonade comes from lemons; you drink it.
mcq.why: Bo learns where lemonade comes from.

mcq.q: Why is Bo's mistake with the noodles funny?
o: You drink lemonade; you don't put it on noodles.
mcq.why: Lemonade is a drink, not a sauce for noodles!

mcq.q: Why is the shed a good place for the Discovery Team?
o: It's quiet and they can decorate it.
It has a lot of bread.
mcq.why: A quiet place is good for team meetings.
